answer_1.quote: The rapid advancements of large language models in recent years has enabled the development of dialogue agents that can generate remarkably fluent and natural responses.

answer_4.quote: We gathered 90 individuals via email, social media, and in-person recruiting to test our models.
answer_4.guideline: Each user was instructed to chat with our bot for at least seven turns and then answer a post-chat survey where they rated the quality of the conversation on a scale from 1-5 as well as how well the bot represented its persona during the conversation on a scale from 1-5.
